topic: Data discrepancy investigation and fix deployment
summary_markdown: The conversation covered two main topics: facility data access and analytics data discrepancies. Regarding facilities, a user noted that a specific cluster ID for a golf club was not visible in the campaign editor filter. For analytics, significant time was spent investigating data inconsistencies between production (PROD) and beta environments, particularly concerning timezone handling and footfall metrics. The initial suspicion of timezone differences proved complex; while PROD showed an African timezone but returned UTC data, changing the timezone on the beta environment did not alter the figures. After deploying a fix to the beta environment that corrected a missed limitation in the footfall calculation, the discrepancy persisted. Ultimately, it was decided to accept the current state of the data.
decisions: The team agreed to consider the current analytics data as acceptable despite persistent discrepancies between PROD and Beta environments.
